shortDescription: Configure Infoblox NIOS DHCP Fixed Address

options.name: comment
options.description: Configures a text string comment to be associated with the instance of this object.  The provided text string will be configured on the object instance.

options.name: duid
options.description: The DUID address of the IPv6 interface.

options.name: extattrs
options.description: Allows for the configuration of Extensible Attributes on the instance of the object.  This argument accepts a set of key / value pairs for configuration.

options.name: ipaddr
options.description: IPV4/V6 address of the fixed address.

options.name: mac
options.description: The MAC address of the IPv4 interface. For a fix address reservation specify mac address as 00:00:00:00:00:00

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the hostname with which fixed DHCP ip-address is stored for respective mac.

options.name: network
options.description: Specifies the network range in which ipaddr exists.

options.name: network_view
options.description: Configures the name of the network view to associate with this configured instance.

options.name: options
options.description: Configures the set of DHCP options to be included as part of the configured network instance.  This argument accepts a list of values (see suboptions).  When configuring suboptions at least one of C(name) or C(num) must be specified.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: Configures the intended state of the instance of the object on the NIOS server.  When this value is set to C(present), the object is configured on the device and when this value is set to C(absent) the value is removed (if necessary) from the device.
